name: Eiscafé Bella
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ice Cream Café Bella in Farchant**

Welcome to **Eiscafé Bella**, your cozy spot for delicious ice cream in the heart of **Farchant**, nestled in the beautiful **Tirol** Alps.

Indulge in our creamy homemade ice creams, from classic flavors like vanilla and chocolate to unique specialties like **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or **Kaiserschmarrn** ice cream. Our selection changes seasonally, so every visit brings a new surprise!

Enjoy your treat on our charming outdoor terrace with a view of the stunning **Zugspitze**, or relax inside in our warm, inviting café. Whether you're a local or a traveler exploring the **Tirol** region, **Eiscafé Bella** is the perfect place to pause and savor the sweet moments.

Come by and let us spoil you with the finest ice cream in **Farchant**!
